notes.title: Welcome to the Wild West: Canyon Trials Edition
notes.content: [p align="start"]To launch a Trial, you need to place 3 Silver and 3 Bronze rings on the pedestal. After that, enemies will begin attacking you. Stay alive and kill them all if you want your prize![/p][p align="start"]This location has a 2-day cooldown, but you can reset for a couple of silver coins.[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Waves[/b][/h1][p align="start"][img src="https://static-platform.aghanim.com/news/dc4f545f-0f47-4a84-8cac-560037267d48.webp"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Waves 1-3[/b] — This is a not very complicated intro to give you a chance to prepare for more advanced enemies. The difficulty grows gradually.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wave 4[/b] — The 1st Boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wave 5[/b] — You will face a large number of fast but low HP enemies. A good hummer or a shotgun would be useful for you to win this wave.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wave 6[/b] — You will have to kill 5 Dsonokvas as fast as possible before they cast a powerful AOE-burst. In case you have survived after the first blast, they will start casting it once again. A powerful rifle or a gun will be the best choice to pass this wave successfully.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wave 7[/b] — Survive fighting various enemies and do your best to avoid contact with Buffalo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wave 8[/b] — 2nd Boss fight. In case you have won all of the 8 waves you will face another 8 with increased difficulty. The total number of waves is infinite!  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Bosses[/b][/h1][table equalcells="1" colwidth="156,531"][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/ff9e4d430f572d59a78fa6afa0477ae0384c6623.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="531"][p][b]Wendigo.[/b] You will see two ghosts. If you attack one of them it will try to run away, but the second one will try to hurt you. And every hit will summon a new immortal ghost attacking you. You can attack only the first ghost. When the first ghost loses more than 50% of HP, it will turn into Wendigo and start attacking you as well. The best strategy is to kill the boss using powerful attacks as fast as possible. Don’t try to kill other ghosts. They will disappear right after Wendigo's death. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/fcbf9dc237c4fa1bcce9f56c031f64f803d00e83.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="531"][p][b]Uktena.[/b] When moving, Uktena leaves a fire trail. It will hurt you if you try to cross it. The best strategy here is to hit’n’run, trying to ‘kite’ the boss and to avoid the fire trail. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/8fd6b343c68dd421ea3b4bdecc4ba2bfb7942fa0.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="531"][p][b]Paisa.[/b] Beware of the Piasa! This new boss loves to attack from the rear and deals lots of area damage. It can appear on each 4th or 8th wave.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="156"][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/dc33ac8f91a35061dac24d89830a28dab829aa05.png"][/img][/p][/td][td colwidth="531"][p][b]Dsonokva.[/b] It looks scarier from a distance than it really is in close combat. Get your melee weapon ready! It can appear on each 4th or 8th wave.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h1]Canyon Trials Leaderboard[/h1][p align="start"][img src="https://static-platform.aghanim.com/news/442b3ca9-8646-404b-a078-5cd3f399c53b.webp"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Canyon Trials Leaderboard participants compete within Leagues. There are Bronze, Silver, and Gold Leagues with 5 divisions in each of them.[/p][p align="start"]Your first run in the Canyon Trials is considered a qualifying run. Your performance in that run determines which league you are placed in, with the highest possible placement being Gold 5. [/p][p align="start"]Future battles defines your place within your group. The size of the group is determined by the League you get sorted into. [/p][p align="start"]Canyon Trials Leaderboard refreshes every 6 days. The new competition will begin in 24 hours after the previous one ends. [/p][p align="start"]Let’s make it clear how to get to the top of the Canyon Trials Leaderboard.[/p][list][*][p]Only the best of your completed attempts during the weekly period counts in the Canyon Trials Leaderboard. E.g. if you fought three times during the period and got 97, 101, and 98 points, then your maximum score is 101. And 101 is your result in the Leaderboard.[/p][/*][*][p]You get points for every killed creature in the Canyon. The tougher the foe, the more points you get for dealing with them![/p][/*][*][p]Additional points are given for the time it takes to deal with enemy waves. The faster you are, the more points you get![/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Rewards[/b][/h1][p align="start"]You get rewards both for completing each Canyon Trials fight and for your place in leaderboard by the end of the 6 days competitions.[/p][list][*][p][b]Rewards for each fight:[/b] Rings of power, Refined sugar and Silver coins;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboard rewards:[/b] Gold Nuggets (starting from Gold League), Native American weapons, armor and tubes, rare tubes and useful resources.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the Wild West: Spirit Cave Edition
notes.content:
[p]☠️ Some say the cave's haunted. Others say it's just full of secrets — and bones. 
Deep underground, totems stir and ancient curses test your grit. But those who dare… ride out rich.
Pick your buffs, brave the fog, and let the spirits judge your worth.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]⚔️ Rooms, Bosses & Leagues[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/decef454ba2cf884af74890bef8d50e659422ce8.png"][/img]The cave is split into rooms, each filled with enemies. After clearing one, you choose a bonus that’ll help you through the next. Every three rooms, you face a boss — tougher, meaner, but with better loot.

Each League adds more rooms and bosses:
[/p][list][*][p]Bronze: 9 rooms, 3 bosses
    [/p][/*][*][p]Silver: 12 rooms, 4 bosses
    [/p][/*][*][p]Gold: 15 rooms, 5 bosses
[/p][/*][/list][p]Even if you drop to 0 HP, you won't die — you'll hang on with just 1 HP, giving you a fighting chance to continue.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌿 Powers of the Ancients[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/44ab76b5ca8a5d0c131875db0958459f01163a27.png"][/img]After each room, you choose a power. Some are common, some rare, some legendary — and the deeper you go, the better they get.

Common Powers (12 total): stat boosts like bonus damage, resistance to debuffs, faster healing, or even an extra life.

Uncommon & Rare Powers: summon spirit allies, bounce attacks, explosions on kill, enemy slow effects, health regen auras, and more.

Epic Powers: powerful fused abilities like Spirit Bear form (deal AoE damage with knockback), Frost Trail (leave ice patches that slow enemies), Explosive Shot, Dual Arrows, Firestorm slashes, or deadly Traps.

A full run usually offers around 5–6 powers — choose carefully and build smart.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🏆 Climb the Ranks[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/5c2aa7563ea01e832d36c6ed572c687fa0378e47.png"][/img]All players start in the Bronze League, with the chance to climb to Silver and then Gold. Higher leagues mean more challenges, more rooms, and better rewards.

Compete for leaderboard placement each week. Rankings reset every Saturday at 12:00 UTC. The higher you place, the better the loot:
💰 Gold, 🪓 rare gear, 🍖 buffs, and even a few drinks to toast your victories.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🎁 Totem Chests & the Endless Wave[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/a61363c9cb2aa5592e67398e703376287fd42c2f.png"][/img]Each boss drops a treasure chest. The deeper you go, the better the loot: Native-style weapons and armor, rare materials, and sometimes special crafting ingredients.

After defeating the final boss, you can leave — or stay and fight in the Endless Wave. Survive for as long as you can against ever-tougher enemies. Every extra room means extra rewards — but no mercy.
Even death won’t kick you out — it’ll leave you with 1 HP… just enough to keep going if you dare.
[/p][hr][/hr][quote][p] [b]Please note[/b]: Spirit Cave is not available in the Steam demo and will be introduced with the full PC release. Add Westland Survival to your [url="https://bit.ly/steam_wishlists"] wishlist [/url] to stay updated. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/cd72d1667005f60849bd2e02d755f331641489bd.gif"][/img][/p][/quote]

notes.title: Welcome to the Wild West: Ranch Edition
notes.content:
[p]This time, we’re headin’ back to where it all begins: your Ranch. 🛠️ It ain’t just four walls and a roof — it’s your shelter, your workshop, your fortress on the frontier. Whether you’re crafting gear, raising foals, or prepping for your next ride, this is where the real groundwork happens.

Let’s hammer out the basics and turn that dusty plot into a home worth fightin’ for!
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ Home Sweet Ranch[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/0418dd85c856089b0ad8a7ba47beca71d4af6502.png"][/img]Your Ranch is more than just home — it’s your stronghold. A place to rest, gear up, and build everything you need to survive out West.

You can only build it at the Home location. To enter building mode, tap the little white house icon under the minimap. From there, you can:
[/p][list][*][p]lay down floors
    [/p][/*][*][p]raise walls, place doors and windows
    [/p][/*][*][p]craft benches and other furniture
[/p][/*][/list][p]How building works:
Choose an object, check the required materials, and if you’ve got ‘em — build away! Just make sure the floor is the right tier, or the item won’t fit.

Want to upgrade?
[/p][list][*][p]Tap the up-arrow in build mode to see what’s needed
    [/p][/*][*][p]No button? Try switching tabs in the lower menu to refresh
[/p][/*][/list][p]Moving constructions:
Most objects can be moved — just not walls, floors, or the broken cart outside. Enter build mode, tap the item, and hit the crosspiece icon.

Destroying constructions:
Feel free to tear stuff down — you’ll get all materials back.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]✉️ Cody Express Delivers![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/e30445b1f11cf08c60831c93687cc3d5df764778.png"][/img]There’s a new face in town — Speedy Cody and his fresh-started Postal Service. That shiny Mailbox at your Ranch? Yep, that’s his doing. You can move it around if it’s in the way — no fuss.

Here’s how the new system works:
[/p][list][*][p]All in-game rewards now go straight to your Ranch or Deepwater Mailbox
    [/p][/*][*][p]Mail stays there for 30 days, so don’t forget to collect it
    [/p][/*][*][p]Shop purchases show up in the Orders tab inside the Shop menu
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🌾 Fields of Fortune[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/462fbcb688e5784da8155a02dd72f39427548dce.png"][/img]Tired of garden beds? It’s time to upgrade your farming game — Fields are here to make your Ranch greener and your harvest richer.

How to get started:
[/p][list][*][p]Build your first Field via building mode — just like with any other structure
    [/p][/*][*][p]Want to upgrade it? You’ll need Mineral Fertilizer, found at the Emergency Stop event
    [/p][/*][*][p]You can build multiple Fields, but their number depends on your Well or Water Tower level
[/p][/*][/list][p]And here’s the real kicker — Fields give seeds back when you harvest crops. That means self-sustaining farming and an endless supply of food if you play it smart.

Planting & Harvesting:
[/p][list][*][p]One Field = one crop
    [/p][/*][*][p]When sowing, all seeds from your inventory are used at once
    [/p][/*][*][p]Harvests mature together, not one by one like in garden beds
    [/p][/*][*][p]Once harvested, you get your crop plus the same number of seeds you used — ready for the next round
[/p][/*][/list][p]With this self-replenishing cycle, the Fields system is both efficient and rewarding. Just keep planting, harvesting, and expanding — and you’ll never run dry.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🌽 Build a Barn[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/8eb5028ab444acefa31ebf8f98c0f7bd02a90911.png"][/img]Growin’ crops is hard work — and if your harvest is pilling up, it’s time to stash it proper. That’s where the Barn comes in.

This special storage keeps seeds, crops, fiber, and compound feed safe and sound — freeing up room in your Food and Wood storages. Clean, organized, and mighty convenient.

How to get one?
Head into building mode, then tap the Projects tab — you’ll find the Barn ready to raise.

Worried about bandits? Don’t be. They’ve got no interest in seeds or horse chow, so your Barn is safe during raids.
[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🐾 Livestock Life: Ranch Animals[/h2][p]
A true Ranch ain’t just walls and benches — it’s alive. And if you’re lookin’ to boost your supplies and feed both folks and beasts, it’s time to raise livestock.

[/p][h3]🐄 Cowshed[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/67cafde8fedbe15eeadf0beec2d392f09f0f28d1.png"][/img]Build a Cowshed to raise cattle and produce top-grade Fillets. Cows grow over time and need feed only once — they’ll happily chew through anything, but special cow fodder gives the best results. To grow your herd, upgrade the shed and keep that feeder full. Butchering cows requires the Farming workbench, so make sure it’s up to snuff.

[/p][h3]🐔 Chicken Coop[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/c0166ea66c22d2b6301ab566ed64a5ffd8e1644d.png"][/img]Looking to make your pets happy or stock up on meat? Set up a Chicken Coop and raise your own poultry. Chickens are low-maintenance: feed ‘em once, and they’ll hatch and grow on their own. Once mature, they can be turned into meat using the Farming workbench. Just don’t forget — you’ll need a Breeding Rooster to get things started.

[/p][h3]🐎 Stables[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/5615616e824e44b5d011b573e6c4030531eeb9e8.png"][/img]Every good traveler needs a horse — and every horse needs a home. Stables give your steeds a place to rest, regain Energy, and breed foals. Feed them with crops or Horse Feed for slow recovery, or give them Sugar Treats for an instant boost. As you upgrade the Stable, you’ll unlock more slots for horses and strengthen your herd.


[/p][quote][p] [b]Please note[/b]: most of the described systems are not available in the Steam demo and will be introduced with the full PC release. Add Westland Survival to your [url="https://bit.ly/steam_wishlists"] wishlist [/url] to stay updated — and be among the first to raise loyal companions once the full game launches. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/cd72d1667005f60849bd2e02d755f331641489bd.gif"][/img][/p][/quote]

notes.title: Welcome to the Wild West: Mounts Edition
notes.content:
In this chapter, we’re diving into one of the most important companions you’ll ever have out on the frontier.

We’re talkin’ horses. 🐎 Swift, strong, and loyal, your horse isn’t just for show — it’s your ticket to distant lands, special events, and hard-to-reach locations. While you rest, it runs — burning its own Energy so you can save yours for the real action.

Let’s break down how breeding works and what it takes to raise the finest steed west of the Rockies!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]🐾 Getting in the Saddle[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/d37dec9d0e7b5df7c35d624bb55db4e5ed05b55e.png[/img]
You’ll get your first horse once you build the [b]Stables[/b] — your one-stop spot for managing up to 8 horses. Here, you can swap mounts, let them rest to regain Energy, feed them, and start breeding new foals.

New horses come from two places: either purchased from Arabella Gallopridge in Silverton or bred right at home. Unlike pets, you can’t tame a wild stallion — every steed must be earned.

Each horse comes with its own stats: Energy (used for travel), Speed (how fast it gets there), and Endurance (how far it can go without tiring). Choose wisely, partner.

[hr][/hr]


[h2]🐴 Horse Stats & How to Restore Energy[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/04f2386e1d3b93420b62a73f2af7d256f414ac28.png[/img]
Every horse in Westland Survival has three key stats: Energy, Speed, and Endurance.

Horse Energy is your steed’s stamina — it fuels travel across the global map, whether you’re riding solo or hauling a Wagon. Once it runs dry, you’ll have to continue on foot, leading your tired companion by the reins. But don’t worry — each horse has its own Energy pool. Swap a tired one for a fresh mount back at the Ranch and keep going!

Horses regain Energy in two ways:

[b]Stable Recovery:[/b] Leave a horse at the Ranch and make sure the Feeder’s stocked. Horses can eat any crops, but Horse Feed made from Oats and Corn works best.

[b]Horse Sugar Treats:[/b] Instantly refills Energy — same as before, but now with a new name.

Speed affects how fast Energy drains while riding, and Endurance determines Energy use when pulling a Wagon. Balance your mount’s stats with your mission — and you’ll go far.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]🧬 Perks That Make a Difference[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/97c20bf7eabef4a0103db934c908b4b50eaa2061.png[/img]

Beyond stats, every horse comes with at least one innate perk — a unique trait that gives it an edge. The rarest steeds can even roll two!

Here’s what your horse might be packing:

[list]
    [*]Energetic – Higher max Energy
    [*]Increased Speed / Endurance – Boosts to travel efficiency
    [*]Thrifty – Eats less from the Feeder
    [*]Fast Metabolism – Restores Energy faster in the Stable
    [*]Sweet Tooth – Gets more Energy from Sugar Treats
    [*]Cargo Carrier – Extra inventory slots (very rare!)
[/list]

Just like pets, perk rarity is independent of the horse’s tier — even a common mount might surprise you with something special.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎠 Breeds & Types: Find Your Perfect Horse[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/21e096510029fbeb0c707653b34f3fcae4de522b.png[/img]
Breeding is your ticket to building a powerful herd — with a chance at rare foals, flashy coats, and better stats. But it’s not just about pairing up any two horses.

You can only breed horses of the same type (Riding or Draft), but their breeds can differ — the foal inherits one of the parents’. Coat color usually follows suit, though new variations may appear if both breeds allow it.

For best results, pair horses of the same tier and rarity — it boosts the odds of stronger offspring. Breeding won’t work without food in the Feeder, and once born, foals need proper feeding to grow into adults. They can’t travel or be sold until they mature.

Each horse has a limited number of breedings, determined by its Fertility stat. It can be replenished with Equine Elixir, but that’s a rare find, available only in the in-game shop.

Raise them right — and you just might raise a legend.

[quote=author] [b]Please note[/b]: the mount system is not available in the Steam demo and will be introduced with the full PC release. Add Westland Survival to your [url=https://bit.ly/steam_wishlists] wishlist [/url] to stay updated — and be among the first to raise loyal companions once the full game launches.

[/quote]

notes.title: Welcome to the Wild West: Pets Edition
notes.content:
Westland Survival is packed with exciting systems — from base building and exploration to shootouts and survival. This post marks the start of a new series, [b]Welcome to the Wild West[/b], shining a light on the game’s most iconic features.
First up: [b]pets[/b]. Loyal companions, fierce defenders, or just adorable mischief-makers — they’re an essential part of life on the Ranch. Let’s take a closer look at how they work!
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🐾 Pets in Westland Survival — Tame, Train, and Breed[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/9509ade60a3202b67f45a95c31c908f7e67431fe.jpg[/img]
In Westland Survival, wild animals can become trusted allies. Once tamed, they’ll follow you, fight for you, and grow stronger with every adventure.

To start your pet journey, you’ll need to build a Pet House and a Bait Workbench. Each species prefers a specific bait — craft it, venture into the wild, and carefully lure the animal back to your Ranch. Feed your new companion, give it time to adapt, and you’ll soon gain a loyal friend.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🏡 The Pet House[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/ab68b4d0d4920ecea749b65e654e508dfb9de656.jpg[/img]
The Pet House is your pets’ home base. It lets you care for multiple animals, heal them after battles, and feed them through a shared Feeder.

Once upgraded to level two, it also unlocks breeding — allowing you to raise the next generation of companions.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🧬 Breeding System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/988f30a5b4eed3ade6ec60d0b22b5df129ecc439.jpg[/img]
Breeding is a powerful feature available in the full version of the game. Combine two pets of the same species and different genders to create an offspring.

Newborn pets inherit looks and perks from their parents, and may even surpass them early in life. Some animals carry the Strong Genes trait, which guarantees that the offspring inherits the color and strength of the more powerful parent.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🧠 Perks & Stats[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/95b096f134fc6ca3f4aac0dcff401b57e714e92a.jpg[/img]
Pets have combat abilities that make a real difference. Some perks trigger in battle — like bleed, slow, or bonus damage. Others grant permanent bonuses: more health, faster movement, or increased healing.

As your pet gains experience, it levels up — unlocking more potential and making every fight a step toward strength.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🍖 Baits and Unlocking New Species[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/f92ba11aff7669e5104c32a525e4062919fe7a5d.png[/img]
Some species require a specific bait. By bringing pets to Vernon in the Nature Park, you’ll earn knowledge points and unlock new species.

Your progress is tracked in the Encyclopedia. The most powerful species — like alligators — become available only after you’ve mastered others.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🐶 Decorative Ranch Pets[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/bd03425d34670c4c6bc3948b20b11d95849fb687.jpg[/img]
Not all pets are fighters. Some — like cats, corgis, or even turkeys — are purely decorative. You can buy them from a traveling merchant or unlock them during special events.

Build a Pet Bed to let your new friend wander around the Ranch and keep you company.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]🎯 Play the Demo Now[/h2]
Play the [url=steam://install/3693910 style=button]DEMO[/url] and try a small taste of the Wild West, where you can craft, fight, and survive. Get a feel for the core mechanics and see what life on the frontier is all about! The full version will expand the system with breeding mechanics, rarer species, and more powerful companions.

[quote=author] [b]Please note[/b]: the pet system is not available in the Steam demo and will be introduced with the full PC release. Add Westland Survival to your [url=https://bit.ly/steam_wishlists] wishlist [/url] to stay updated — and be among the first to raise loyal companions once the full game launches. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001395/cd72d1667005f60849bd2e02d755f331641489bd.gif[/img]
[/quote]
